# @three-ws/assets

> Find a ready-made 3D prop, rigged character, or motion clip on three.ws and add it to your project with the code that renders it. Free and public: no account, no API key, no payment.

@three-ws/assets is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/assets`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assets/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-assets/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-assets/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assets/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
